s.note: Mini pizzas with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni.
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough thin and cut 16 rounds with a glass. Top each with a spoon of pizza sauce, using 150ml, a pinch of grated mozzarella, 150g in total, and a slice of pepperoni. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes until golden underneath.

s.note: Potato and slow onion in puff pastry logs with hot mustard.
s.how: Boil 500g peeled potatoes 15 minutes and mash. Cook 1 diced brown onion in 30g butter over low heat for 15 minutes and mix in with salt and white pepper. Spread along 2 sheets puff pastry, roll into logs, cut into 8 and brush with 1 beaten egg. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 40g hot English mustard.

m.note: Sliced sirloin on ciabatta with slow onions, rocket and horseradish cream.
m.how: Cook 2 sliced brown onions in butter over low heat for 30 minutes until jammy. Sear 2 sirloin steaks, about 600g, hard for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin. Split and toast 4 pieces of ciabatta, spread with 100g horseradish cream and pile with steak, onions and 60g rocket.

w.note: Green, white and red almond layers with jam and chocolate.
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 200g sugar, then 4 eggs, 200g almond meal and 150g flour. Divide in 3, tint one green and one red, and bake each in a lined 20x30cm tin at 180C for 12 minutes. Stack with 150g apricot jam between, press under a tray overnight, spread with 150g melted dark chocolate and cut into small squares.

d.note: A double espresso poured over tonic, ice and fresh orange, bitter, bright and fizzy enough to keep you sharp.
d.how: Brew 4 double espressos and let them cool for 5 minutes. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a thin orange slice each. Pour 150ml chilled tonic water into each glass. Slowly pour a double espresso over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Stir at the table.
